patch.reasoning: The recurring failures are already addressed by the skill’s cache-coverage, refinement, result-saving, schema-validation, and separate-flight-leg instructions. The trajectories mainly disregard those instructions rather than reveal a new generalizable gap; adding similar guidance would duplicate existing content and repeat previously rejected edits.
